LANCHAI — Cancellation policy

Effective date: 2 November 2026

Free cancellation before pick-up

You can cancel your booking for free, at any time before pick-up. Nothing is paid online and there is no advance — nothing is charged before pick-up.

How to cancel

If you can't come, please cancel in the LANCHAI app (My rentals → your rental → Cancel) so someone else can rent the item. You can also contact us at contact@lanchai.la.

No-show

If you don't come to pick up a booking and haven't cancelled it, we may mark it as a no-show. The booking is released and nothing is charged, but new bookings are paused until you contact us.

Security deposit

The security deposit is only collected in store at pick-up, so a cancellation before pick-up never involves your deposit.

Questions? contact@lanchai.la
